name: HYDRA-UMC-PATH-PLANNER-3D
notes: Real RRT-based 3D path planner, tested against real obstacle/workspace scenarios (not yet RRT* - no rewiring pass). Real wall-clock planning time limit (PlannerConfig.max_duration_ms) independent of max_iterations, a reusable obstacle/workspace test corpus, and a new `validate` subcommand that re-checks an externally-supplied path for safety (workspace bounds, obstacle clearance, segment-level collisions) before it is trusted for real execution. The nearest-neighbour search is a KD-tree rebuilt balanced as it grows and walked without recursion; the workspace is the volume the whole body must stay in (robot_radius is kept clear of its walls); validate also requires the path to begin at the scenario start and end at its goal; stdout carries only the JSON result; 66 tests.
